en.08933600828b8a218248f6ad description: You want to earn my trust? Did you figure out who's unhappy with Skier, or did you just point your finger at the sky? Doesn't matter. Sell weapons to Skier so he can understand that he's forgiven. And get me the cell phone that his men were stashing at the dorms. Let's find out what so many people died for.

en.0c854decadc06f37535cb8b2 description:
Hello. Remember when I was hoping the laptop would be easy to hack into? I was wrong, it's encrypted after all. I don't want to give the laptop to Mechanic, he could sell the information to an outside party. I don't want to take any more risks.

I've already found the right people, but now I need your help. I need to hand these people a payment at Customs, at the weather station, and show that you've done it. Of course, this is not going to be a face-to-face meeting. I'll give you the flare launcher and pay you afterward, don't worry.
en.0c854decadc06f37535cb8b2 successMessageT: Fast and smooth as always. I have already been contacted and the data will be decrypted soon.
en.10da0c610a62dee1c0f02d7d description:
I know a lot of idiots, but I've never seen anyone as fucking stupid as you. I told you not to trade with them.

All right, I'll give you one last chance. Last chance, you hear me? Otherwise, you get nothing once we've dealt with Skier and Peacekeeper.
en.10da0c610a62dee1c0f02d7d failMessageText: You blew your chance to profit. We'll deal with these lovebirds without you.
en.10da0c610a62dee1c0f02d7d successMessageT: Barely pulled it off. Your reward.

en.2705cab9f82d5cc3875f8cd9 description: Hi. I realize time is tight, but I'm having trouble with this flash drive. I'm gonna need some tools. You can't just find them in Tarkov, you have to know certain people. One of them needs a military gyrotachometer, so we'll barter. Take it and plant it on the Reserve base at the radar station, inside the dome. The sooner you do it, the better.
en.2705cab9f82d5cc3875f8cd9 successMessageT: That was fast. Thank you. Here, this is for your help.
en.2726e1564b5c9b25b1df20d6 description: Hey, friend. There's been an unexpected emergency. No, I decrypted the flash drive, sent it with my guys. But somebody intercepted them. I heard on the radio they got gunned down. Horrible. The attackers were obviously after the flash drive. This is a dangerous business I've gotten myself into... Anyway, I gotta honor my promises anyway. I need your help again. The shooting happened at Customs. I don't think the attackers have gotten very far. Chase them down and take them out. You might want to just give the flash drive straight to Skier. More secure that way.
en.2726e1564b5c9b25b1df20d6 successMessageT: What, you couldn't find the flash drive? Now we have to do it all over again. I don't have time for this. Here's the decryption program. When you find a new flash drive, decrypt it and give it to whoever you decide, I don't care anymore.

But there's a lot of wild scum out there lately, so I don't want them to blow the whistle on our stuff. You gonna shoot 'em, ye? Don't worry, I'll give you repeaters, but don't think it's a reusable campaign! You and Mechanic will make new ones on your own if you lose them.

ch.2705cab9f82d5cc3875f8cd9 description: 嗨，我知道 Skier 那边催的很紧，但我确实遇到了问题。我需要其他工具才能破译这块 U 盘，但问题是这些东西在塔科夫可不是俯拾皆是，你得找那几个特定的供货商才行。其中有人需要一个军用转速计，因此我们商量好以物易物。把这个拿去，藏在储备站的雷达站顶上，那个穹顶里面。这件事办得越快越好。
ch.2705cab9f82d5cc3875f8cd9 successMessageT: 还挺快。谢谢你，给这是你应得的。
ch.2726e1564b5c9b25b1df20d6 description: 你好啊，朋友。现在又有意外情况发生了。不，那块 U 盘我已经破译好，让我的人送回去了。但显然有人出手拦截了他们。我在无线电里亲耳听见他们被袭击者打倒的惨状……实在是太可怕了。那些人肯定是奔着 U 盘来的，当初就不该卷进这么危险的生意里……无论如何，既然我答应了 Skier，总得信守承诺，因此我又得拜托你帮忙了。整场惨案是在海关发生的，我猜袭击者应该还没跑远。追上他们，把这些人全部干掉。如果你找到了 U 盘，就直接带去给 Skier。这样总归安全点。
ch.2726e1564b5c9b25b1df20d6 successMessageT: 什么？你没找到那个 U 盘？现在我们又得从头再来一遍了，我可没时间继续弄这个。这是破译程序，要是你找到了另一块 U 盘，就用这个去解密好了。至于交给谁随你的便，我不在乎。

Both of these crooks are running silent. We need to figure out what they're up to. According to my intel, they've been communicating with each other. You know, one of them sends a messenger, the messenger hides a note in a safe house, the other messenger picks it up. I'm sure you've done this kind of shit yourself. My people managed to find out the location of the note. Go down to the village on Shoreline and bring me their damn notes.
ch.b84dd58f40351eb7fc6c3ae0 successMessageT: Let's see what they're chatting about. In the meantime, here's your reward.

ch.c6a55e64d8b664c95967ee01 description:
嘿，老伙计，看样子我们惹到什么不该惹的大人物了。现在这出闹剧变成彻头彻尾的陷害了！我还以为在自个的底盘上能讲点“民主”呢，但不成！总有别的傻逼窜出来管天管地。 

好了，就抱怨到这。我们得想办法在被他们拖垮前修复关系，让局势向有利的一面发展。我们会把那个手机还回去，还到那个什么秘密交货点。现在去海关工人住的那个宿舍，把地方清理干净，然后物色个能让我的狗腿顺利藏匿手机的地方。之后就是“合适的人”来接手了。

我猜这通折腾都是为了“赎罪”，靠。
ch.c6a55e64d8b664c95967ee01 successMessageT: 希望这回他们总该滚蛋了。
